About this documentation set

Example Docs exists to describe its own build. Each page is a markdown file in one collection, rendered by one layout, written to disk by one command. There is no editor, no database and no request-time work of any kind.

The pages carry no advertising, no comment form and no reader accounts, so a reader arriving from anywhere sees the same bytes. That is a deliberate limit rather than an omission: the narrower the site, the easier it is to say exactly what each published file contains.

Corrections belong in the markdown file the page was built from. The entry ids under Routing name the files directly, so a reader who spots an error can find the source without searching for it.

Example Docs is a fixture. Its pages describe how it is built and nothing else.
